races.display_title: British EBF 'National Hunt' Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict: This looks a good opportunity for fairly useful bumper performer TURBOCHARGED to make a successful start over hurdles. races.display_title: Insurance Connections Best Bet Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict: SAFE DESTINATION was below form on his final 2 starts last season, but he returns with his yard going well so is worth another chance from only 2 lb above his last winning mark. Camarrate isn't taken lightly, though, following his encouraging chasing debut at this course, with last year's winner of this race Fern Hill also in the mix. SAFE DESTINATION CAMARRATE (IRE) FERN HILL (IRE)

races.display_title: 100 Punting Feats And Bad Beats 'Chasing Excellence' Mares' Beginners' Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict: Preference is for FOLIE GOLITH , who has already run to a fairly useful level over fences with a pair of runner-up efforts in listed events in France. She can put that experience to good use to make a winning stable debut, with Siog Geal the pick for second as the highest rated of these over hurdles, ahead of Getawhisky . FOLIE GOLITH (FR) SIOG GEAL (IRE) GETAWHISKY

races.verdict: VENETIAN LION still looks ahead of his mark and may enhance William Haggas' fine recent record in this race if coping with conditions. Mudlarks Thunder Roar and The Resdev Scholar are next best in an open-looking handicap, with Lir Speciale another to note on this sort of ground. VENETIAN LION THUNDER ROAR THE RESDEV SCHOLAR (IRE)

races.verdict: The drop back to 5f is possibly not ideal for IRISH NECTAR , but he won with such a degree of authority at Leicester on Tuesday that he could take some stopping under a penalty if getting the breaks. races.verdict: YAFAARR has thrived for the recent fitting of cheekpieces and is fancied to defy a 7 lb rise in the weights and notch a hat-trick at the chief expense of recent Wolverhampton scorer Variety Act . races.display_title: Central Employment & Training Partnership Handicap (Div 1)
races.verdict: COULSTY EXCHANGE shaped much better than the bare result when sixth on handicap debut at this track a fortnight ago, making late headway under a hands-and-heels ride at 6f. The return to 7f should suit and she can make the breakthrough in a weak affair. Dream Forever has a solid course record and looks by far her biggest danger. COULSTY EXCHANGE (IRE) DREAM FOREVER (IRE) HEY HAVANA (IRE)

races.verdict: Cases can be made for any number of these but the most persuasive is for MOOSTAR , who finally broke her duck for this yard at Leicester 10 days ago and James Owen's filly escapes a penalty. Handily berthed in stall 2, she can get the better of Highfield Viking , who got off the mark for the year at Ayr recently and remains on a workable mark based on last year's form. Reginald Charles and Filey Beach are another couple with a squeak, as well. MOOSTAR HIGHFIELD VIKING REGINALD CHARLES

races.verdict: Back on all-weather for stable debut, FIREWALKER showed much improved form when runner-up in a handicap here last month, beaten only by a thriving rival. races.display_title: View Restaurant At Dundalk Stadium Handicap
races.verdict: EASTERN PEACE has dropped to a handy mark and signalled she is ready to strike again when staying on into third over 9f at Punchestown last time so looks the way to go back over this longer trip. Enchanted Lady could emerge as the main danger now back on polytrack, although Limestone Red , Avec Grand Plaisir and Tribal Moon can all have a say too in this very open handicap. EASTERN PEACE (IRE) ENCHANTED LADY LIMESTONE RED (IRE)
